note: Campground on a private ~10-acre lake between I-80 (Exit 179) and the Platte River at North Platte. Pull-throughs for any size RV, plus primitive and tent areas along the lake. Swimming beaches, catch-and-release fishing with no permit needed, and kayak and paddle-boat rentals. Off-season (Oct 1-Apr 14) is self-registration at the office dropbox, with water only at sites H-X and no showers. Reservations by phone with a $10 deposit. --Claude
